svg.title: Production-Scale Vacation-Rental Marketplace Architecture
svg.desc: Full-scale architecture diagram for an Airbnb-scale marketplace showing scaling strategy across Frontend, Gateway, Microservices, Event Streaming, Storage, Search, and Cloud Deployment.

g.text: Scaling Blueprint: Frontend & SSR • API Gateway & BFF • Microservices • Storage & CDC • Geo Search • AWS EKS Deployment
Client apps, Edge SSR, Stale-While-Revalidate & Asset Delivery
Listing PDP, Dynamic Calendar, Guest Picker, Interactive Modal Tour
• Code-split PhotoTour.jsx via React.lazy() | Bundle: <120KB initial
Native Mobile Clients (iOS Swift / Android Kotlin)
GraphQL Mobile API Consumer with offline draft caching & push sync
DDoS Shield • Edge HTML Cache (SWR 24h) • SSL Termination
Cloudflare Images / Lambda@Edge: On-the-fly WebP/AVIF generation
• 98.2% Cache Hit Ratio on static assets & pre-rendered PDP HTML
Traffic routing, GraphQL federation, auth, rate limiting & mTLS
Ultra-low latency L4 Passthrough • Multi-AZ Anycast IP Routing
• Schema Stitching: Combines Listing, Pricing, Host & Reviews into 1 query
• Auth: JWT verification, OAuth2 & Role-Based Access Control (Guest/Host)
• Distributed Rate Limiting: Redis sliding-window token bucket (per IP/user)
mTLS Zero-Trust Encryption • Circuit Breaking • Outlier Detection • W3C Tracing
Elastic Kubernetes, GitOps CI/CD, Canary & Telemetry
Pod Autoscaler (HPA) via CPU & Custom RPS Metrics
• Karpenter: Provisions right-sized Graviton EC2 nodes in <45s
• Rollback threshold: >0.05% error rate or >15% P99 latency drift
OpenTelemetry Traces • Prometheus Metrics • Datadog APM • PagerDuty
• P99 Latency SLA: <150ms for PDP | Availability: 99.99%
3. Core Domain Microservices Tier (Docker Containers on Kubernetes EKS)
Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with decoupled services communicating via gRPC (synchronous) and Kafka (asynchronous)
Non-blocking replication from Aurora Postgres WAL logs into Kafka (<200ms)
Real-time Search Index Sync • Fraud Velocity Detection • Dynamic Pricing Features
Data storage architecture matched strictly to access patterns (Read/Write ratios, ACID vs Eventual Consistency)
Sharded by Uber H3 Hexagonal Grid
